definitions.explanation: the company or location where one works

examples.japanese: {勤務先|きんむさき}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{住所|じゅうしょ}→住所：01430_juusho⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{教|おし}えて→教える：00526_oshieru⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please tell me your workplace address.

examples.japanese: {勤務先|きんむさき}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{駅|えき}→駅：02180_eki⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{近|ちか}い→近い：00530_chikai⟧です⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。
examples.english: Is your workplace close to the station?

examples.japanese: ⟦{書類|しょるい}→書類：01103_shorui⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{勤務先|きんむさき}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{電話番号|でんわばんごう}→電話番号：10159_denwabangou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{記入|きにゅう}→記入：02624_kinyuu⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please fill in your workplace phone number on the form.

notes:
FORMS:
⟦{勤務|きんむ}→勤務：04545_kinmu⟧ (work, duty) + ⟦{先|さき}→先：02883_saki⟧ (place, destination) → place of work

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{職場|しょくば}→職場：04164_shokuba⟧ (workplace - more common in casual speech)
- ⟦{会社|かいしゃ}→会社：00607_kaisha⟧ (company)
- ⟦{勤|つと}め{先|さき}→勤め先：21550_tsutomesaki⟧ (place of employment - similar)
- ⟦{勤務|きんむ}→勤務：04545_kinmu⟧ (work, duty)

USAGE:
{勤務先|きんむさき} is commonly used on official forms and documents. In casual conversation, ⟦{職場|しょくば}→職場：04164_shokuba⟧ or simply ⟦{会社|かいしゃ}→会社：00607_kaisha⟧ is more common. ⟦{勤|つと}め{先|さき}→勤め先：21550_tsutomesaki⟧ has a similar meaning and is also used on forms.

FORM FIELDS:
- {勤務先|きんむさき}{名|めい} (employer name)
- {勤務先|きんむさき}⟦{住所|じゅうしょ}→住所：01430_juusho⟧ (work address)
- {勤務先|きんむさき}⟦{電話番号|でんわばんごう}→電話番号：10159_denwabangou⟧ (work phone number)
